description: On the table in front of you there’s a small white AirPods charging case. The left hand and right hand move in toward the case to make it a two-hand object, then the right hand flips the lid open and lifts one earbud out to the right, while the left hand steadies the open case; next, the right hand reaches back in to remove the second earbud and both earbuds end up on the table as the left hand closes the case.
